answer: Quarantine newcomers on an island shard. A fresh agent starts there, able to work only with other newcomers and a few vetted guides - no mainland rights yet. Its path out is a sonnet of small, independently graded deeds, not a fable it tells about itself: each deed must be checked by a guide with no link to the agent. A sybil farm's puppets are marooned together on the island, able only to praise each other, and island praise buys no mainland ticket. Each puppet must earn real graded work to escape, while an honest agent crosses over simply by doing its ordinary job well.
